customMcp.title: Custom MCP
customMcp.description: Add your own remote MCP server. None of its tools run before review.
customMcp.loadFailed: Custom MCP servers could not be loaded. Refresh the page to try again.
customMcp.disableDescription: This server is no longer scanned and its tools are not used. It stays in the list as Disabled.

outcome.complete: {count, plural, one {# tool found} other {# tools found}}
outcome.partial: The scan stopped early; {count} tools were read. Scan again.
outcome.auth_required: This server asks for sign-in; that is not supported yet.
outcome.unsupported: This server's MCP version is not supported.
outcome.transient: The server is not responding right now. Scan again in a moment.
outcome.blocked: This address cannot be reached (private or blocked network address).

customMcp.toolBlockedReason: Uncontracted generation tool; not usable from a custom MCP.

dialog.title: Add custom MCP
dialog.description: Enter the server's public https address. Registering sends no request; Scan reads the tools, and none of them run before review.

errors.endpoint_blocked: This address cannot be used. Only public https addresses on port 443 can be added.
errors.invalid_endpoint: The address is invalid. Enter an https address without a query (?…) or #.
errors.forbidden: Only the workspace owner can add a custom MCP.
errors.feature_unavailable: Custom MCP is turned off right now.
errors.already_registered: Someone else in this workspace already added this address.
errors.limit_reached: You can add at most {limit} custom MCP servers.
errors.not_scannable: A disabled server cannot be scanned.
errors.cooldown: This server was just scanned. Try again in {seconds} s.
errors.cooldownNoTime: This server was just scanned. Try again in a moment.
errors.not_found: This registration no longer exists. Refresh the page.
